newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Schoute becomes TIACA European industry affairs director.
newsitem.headline: Schoute becomes TIACA European industry affairs director.

text.p: Peter Schoute, Netherlands country manager of Cargolux, has become the European industry affairs director for The International Air Cargo Association (TIACA).

Schoute takes on the part-time role in April, he said. At the same time, he resigns from ACAN, the Dutch air cargo association, where he has been chairman since the organisation's creation in late 1995.
He will also remain in his current post with Cargolux.
His first official TIACA engagement will be in May when the association meets in Paris. During the next three months TIACA will be deciding its main goals will be for the coming year, he said.
